name: - EFVault
fix_description: Storage collision after proxy upgrade: the new implementation constructor/storage layout reordered variables, causing controller to read from wrong slot. assetsPerShare() then calls incorrect address. Fix: in the new implementation constructor/variable declarations, maintain exact same storage layout as previous version. Only append new variables at the end. Use storage gaps (__gap) pattern.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is essentially a single direct call to redeem() after minting/funding ENF balance in the test, with no flash loan, routing, or multi-contract interaction. This suggests a very straightforward protocol/accounting or input-validation issue that an experienced auditor could reproduce quickly.
